title: Wiki page lifecycle: stamps, supersession, and a corroboration gate
description:
Product work from Applied Research (OKF / TrajWiki / WikiSkill / KBevo / C-Unseen).

Problem: compiled wiki pages can look attested while they are stale, generated, or superseded. A cheap model will keep answering from yesterday’s concept thesis. Treating the compiled page as evidence is the TrajWiki failure.

Solution: specify and implement three behaviors. Raw traces stay immutable. The compiled page is the thing that can die. A non-LLM checker enforces stamps. Auto-writing concept pages with no gate is out of scope and forbidden.

Children:
1. Header stamps (provenance, attested vs generated, current vs live)
2. Supersession (old compiled page marked dead; traces untouched)
3. Human include/exclude as a C-Unseen corroboration gate, not “the model thought it was useful”

Acceptance: a cheap model must not treat a superseded or unattested compiled page as live evidence. Fail closed.

comments.author: box
comments.text:
PLAN ONLY. Nobody implements until Ryan says go. Quality owns the board. Specs may be written; no runtime work.

Research steal-list (from Applied Research, 2026-08-29):
- OKF: cheap header stamps; attested computation that actually runs (non-LLM checker). Agent may fill a sanctioned slot (the year). It may not edit the rule (swap the table). A format that only records how to check, and never runs, is the hole we do not ship.
- TrajWiki: compiled page can die; raw traces stay immutable; the wiki is not evidence. Follow stamps back to the source.
- C-Unseen: include/exclude is a corroboration gate, not “the model thought it was useful.”
- Anti-pattern (WikiSkill / SCALE / KBevo): a graph that only grows because the model thought it helped. Auto-write without a human gate is forbidden.

Children: PPY-aa6f0a stamps + attested run, PPY-b088d7 supersession, PPY-9272c8 corroboration gate.
